name: wrongful termination
description: Termination of employment without following the legal procedure prescribed under the Industrial Disputes Act

name: retrenchment
description: Termination of a workman's service by the employer for any reason other than disciplinary action

name: notice period
description: Mandatory advance notice required before retrenchment, closure or termination

name: retrenchment compensation
description: Compensation payable to a workman at the time of retrenchment — 15 days average pay per completed year of service

name: gratuity
description: Lump sum payment made by employer to employee on retirement, resignation or death after 5 years of continuous service

name: continuous service
description: Uninterrupted employment with an employer — required for gratuity eligibility and retrenchment rights

name: minimum wages
description: Minimum rate of wages fixed by the government for scheduled employments

name: overtime
description: Extra wages payable when a worker works beyond normal working hours

name: lay-off
description: Temporary inability of employer to provide work due to shortage of materials, power or other reasons
aliases: asked not to come to work

name: salary delay
description: Failure or delay by employer in paying wages within the prescribed time limit

name: illegal wage deduction
description: Unlawful deductions made from an employee's wages by the employer

name: bonus
description: Annual bonus payable to eligible employees based on profits or productivity

name: strike
description: Cessation of work by workers acting in combination as a collective protest

name: lock-out
description: Temporary closing of a place of employment by the employer as a counter to a dispute

name: factory closure
description: Permanent closing down of an industrial establishment or undertaking

name: transfer of undertaking
description: Change in ownership or management of an establishment — triggers compensation rights for workmen

name: unfair labour practice
description: Actions by employer or trade union that interfere with workers rights to organise or bargain collectively

name: industrial dispute
description: Any dispute or difference between employer and workmen connected with employment, non-employment or conditions of labour

name: working hours
description: Maximum daily and weekly hours of work permissible for employees

name: weekly holiday
description: Mandatory weekly rest day entitlement for employees

name: annual leave
description: Paid leave entitlement for employees per year of service

name: child labour
description: Prohibition on employment of children in commercial establishments

name: gender discrimination in wages
description: Paying different wages to men and women for same or similar work — prohibited under Code on Wages

name: re-employment of retrenched workmen
description: Right of retrenched workmen to be offered re-employment when employer recruits again

name: conditions of service
description: Terms of employment that cannot be changed by employer during pendency of dispute proceedings

name: recovering unpaid wages
description: The forums and procedures for claiming and recovering wages, gratuity, bonus or other dues an employer has failed to pay

name: labour court and tribunal
description: Constitution, powers and procedure of Labour Courts, Industrial Tribunals and National Tribunals, and the awards they make

name: conciliation and settlement
description: Conciliation proceedings, conciliation officers, and the binding effect and operation of settlements and awards

name: penalties for employer offences
description: Punishments, fines and imprisonment prescribed for employers who contravene labour law, and how those offences are prosecuted

name: labour inspector
description: Appointment and powers of Inspectors and Inspector-cum-Facilitators who enforce labour legislation and inspect establishments

name: employment records and registers

name: registration of establishment
description: Registration of shops and commercial establishments, appointment orders, and notifying changes or closure to the Inspector

name: rest interval and spreadover

name: floor wage
description: The floor wage fixed by the Central Government below which no minimum wage may be set

description: Statutory definitions determining who is a workman, employee or employer, and what counts as wages or an industry

name: voluntary arbitration

name: maternity benefit
description: Maternity leave and benefit, medical bonus, nursing breaks, creche facilities, and protection from dismissal during pregnancy

name: compensation for injury at work
description: Employer's liability to pay compensation for death or injury arising out of and in the course of employment, and how that compensation is calculated and claimed
